headline: As of 2026-10-01: 847,492 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 28 of 50 states, D+36.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 847,492 early/mail ballots cast so far across 28 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+36.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (282,381), New Jersey (134,390), Florida (92,707).
